shots.line: In this town, everyone goes out partying except me. At nine, every porch turned pink. Mine stayed dark.
I used to wave from my bedroom. Tonight I shut the curtains. I was tired of watching a party I wasn't invited to.
Then someone knocked. It was Michael, holding a busted speaker and two cups.
I told him you need people to have a party. He looked around my living room and said, I count two.
I plugged in his speaker. Nothing. Outside, every porch light went out. The whole street had lost power.
Michael tapped his cup. I tapped mine back. Then I opened the front door so our beat could reach the street.
He set his little battery lantern on the step. Our porch was the only one still glowing. So we danced.
When the street lit back up, Michael asked if I wanted to go out. I said, we already are. And we kept dancing.
